verdict.rationale: The OCR 4.1 model page links to a "Try in playground" option, so a web playground for trying the OCR model without code appears to exist. That is the only mention, and nothing describes uploading a document or what results are shown. missing for 10: evidence of drag-and-drop document upload, documentation of parse/extract (annotations, tables, blocks) results rendered in the playground, hands-on or independent corroboration of the playground workflow.
